description: Use when testing a web application for XML External Entity injection on an authorized engagement. Covers finding XML parsers (file upload, SOAP, SVG, DOCX, REST with XML bodies), classic in-band file disclosure with external entities, SSRF through XXE, blind out-of-band exfiltration, error-based extraction, and parameter entity tricks that bypass naive filters. Use when any endpoint accepts XML, SVG, Office documents, or SAML messages and might resolve external DTDs.
